objective: Mara returns to Ossary Harbour on the third day of the storm season and learns the Cold Lamp has been dark for three nights.
hook: no boat in the harbour will take her out to it.

objective: Mara reads the keepers' roll and finds her brother's name struck out and another written over it.
hook: the name written over his is one Halloran will not say aloud.

objective: Mara puts the struck name to the warden of Gannet Isle, who rules her brother drowned and the matter closed under wreck law.
hook: Quill offers her a passage home, and a price for taking it.

objective: Mara hires Halloran's boat for the next slack water and learns what he owes the warden and why he cannot refuse her.
hook: they sail in four hours, into the fourth day of the storm.

objective: Mara crosses the Weathering at slack water over the deepest ground in the Banks, and the storm shuts the channel behind her: the search stops being a question she can withdraw from and turns into a crossing she cannot reverse.
hook: behind them the channel goes white, and there is no slack water back for a day.

objective: Mara lands on Calder Rock in the dark and finds the keeper's stair unbarred and wet.
hook: the footprints on the stair are going up, and they are small.

objective: Mara reaches the lighthouse and finds it abandoned.
hook: the lamp is cold.

objective: Mara reads the keeper's log and finds a three-stroke bell entered for her brother eight days before he stopped writing in it.
hook: someone rang a death bell for him while he was still keeping the light.

objective: A salvage man comes up the Rock to inventory the keeper's store under wreck law, and Mara hides on the stair and listens to him count.
hook: he counts the oil casks aloud, and the count is short by eleven.

objective: On Gannet Isle a lamp-wright tells Mara that her brother is alive and that he put the Cold Lamp out himself; the rescue turns into a reckoning and there is no victim left to go and find.
hook: Nell asks her whose side she will be on when she finds him.

objective: Mara finds the Cold Lamp's oil stacked in the island's salvage yard, entered as wreck goods on a nine-day claim.
hook: the claim is dated three days before the lamp went dark.

objective: The warden catches Mara in the yard with the ledger open and offers her a passage for herself and silence about her brother.
hook: Mara tears the page out of the ledger and runs for the flats.

objective: The salvage man runs Mara down on the flats and, instead of holding her, tells her who rang the death bell and what it was for.
hook: he says her brother is out on the Drowned Stair, and the tide is making.

objective: Mara finds her brother alive on the Drowned Stair with the lens and the mechanism he stripped out of the lamp.
hook: the water is at his knees and still rising.

objective: Tem refuses to give up the mechanism, and Mara has to choose between carrying him off the Stair and leaving the light dark another night.
hook: the bell on Calder Rock rings twice, for a wreck, with no light to have warned anyone off it.

objective: Mara goes down the Drowned Stair into the deep water she has refused all her life to cut the lens free of the reef, and comes up a person the water will no longer turn back.
hook: she surfaces with the lens in both arms, and the wreck bell stops.

objective: At slack water Mara and Halloran recross the Weathering to lodge a claim on the keeper's oil inside the nine days, and Halloran settles his debt out of the salvage fee rather than take the warden's money.
hook: the claim is void without the keeper's own hand, and the keeper is still out on the Stair.

objective: Mara brings her brother in off the Stair to the lighthouse, where he signs the claim and agrees to give his account to the roll.
hook: he asks who is going to light the lamp, because it will not be him.

objective: Nell rebuilds the light with the recovered lens and takes the keeper's oath she has refused for two years.
hook: the first sweep of the new beam finds a lugger still in the channel at the turn of the tide.

objective: The warden is held under the article of wreck law she used, and Mara takes the relief keeper's watch on Calder Rock.
hook: Mara stands the first watch, and does not look away from the water.
